pe_assessment: Vendor trailing30.21x/forward15.14x; Q2 GAAP EPS$2.46 includes equity gains while issuer adjusted$2.22 excludes them and now includes SBC. Forward multiple is uncertain; observed revenue/operating growth and liquidity support the growth valuation without annualising quarterly EPS.

debt_analysis: Cash/debt securities$56.586bn versus stated debt$33.366bn, net liquid surplus$23.220bn excluding leases/equity investments. Q2CFO24.077 less PP&E/intangibles2.677 and principal0.059=FCF21.341bn; H1FCF69.895bn.
growth_outlook: Revenue+106%, operating income+124%; Q3$108bn guidance conditional, excludes China DataCenter compute. Cash growth supports demand but $22.346bn AR cash absorption deserves scrutiny.
key_risks: Q2AR cash outflow22.346bn and inventory5.784bn reduce conversion; rapid customer financing/working-capital growth is material.
Customer AI spending concentration, export controls and equity investment exposure can reduce realised returns; forward15.14x may overstate cheapness if growth slows.
key_strengths: Operating-margin strength and positive cashFCF are independently verified.
Liquid debt securities/cash exceed stated debt without counting risky equity holdings.
summary: NVIDIA earns buy from exceptional observed operating growth, high profitability and positive cash generation. Medium confidence reflects slower quarterly cash conversion and concentrated AI spending rather than an absence of financial evidence.
